```{r}
rm(list = ls())

Octo_Biomass_Calc <- read_csv ("C:\\Users\\bwvma\\OneDrive - ucsc.edu\\One Drive Back Up\\R-Studio\\Octodata\\Biomass formula calculator.csv")

Biomass_formula_data <- Octo_Biomass_Calc |> 
  select(length,`weight (g)`,`abalone #`)

Biomass_formula_data
```
```{r}
Calculating_Biomass_graph <- Biomass_formula_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x=length,
    y=`weight (g)`))+
 
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,NA)
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
   method = lm,
   fullrange = TRUE,
   formula = y ~0+ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3),
   colour = "blue"
) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = length,
      y = 0.06858280385283284374953 * length^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * length^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * length),
    colour = "red"
    )


Calculating_Biomass_graph

model <- lm(`weight (g)` ~ 0 + length + I(length^2) + I(length^3),
            data = Biomass_formula_data)

summary(model)
format(model$coefficients, digits = 22, scientific = FALSE)






ggsave(Calculating_Biomass_graph, filename="Calculating_Biomass_Formula_Graph.png",dpi=600, height=7, width=10)
  
# y = 0.06858280385283284374953 * length^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * length^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * length
```
```{r}
Field_Data_Set <- read_csv ("C:\\Users\\bwvma\\OneDrive - ucsc.edu\\One Drive Back Up\\R-Studio\\Octodata\\FINAL DATA SET (BIOMASS CORRECTED).csv")

  mutate(Biomass = 0.06858280385283284374953 * `Shell Length`^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * `Shell Length`^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * `Shell Length`)


Corrected_Biomass_graph <- Corrected_Biomass_data_set |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x=`Shell Length`,
    y=Biomass))+
 
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,NA)
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
   method = lm,
   fullrange = TRUE,
   formula = y ~0+ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3),
   colour = "blue"
)

Corrected_Biomass_data_set
```
